title: Finite surjective descent of truncated nearby-cycle comparison
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian, $f:X\to S$ finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring killed by an integer invertible on $S$, and $K\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Let $p:T\to S$ be finite surjective [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. For every integer $r$, $P_r(f_T,K_T)$ implies $P_r(f,K)$, with $P_r$ as in [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data]. The corresponding implication also holds for full $\Psi$-goodness [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles].

source.place: Lemma 2.6 and its Cech-nerve proof, pp. 4--5; truncated universal variant by the same bounded-below descent spectral sequence. Local archival PDF WANTED; author PDF read online.
